comment: Read at commit dc4aa7f, the repository head; cf19c15 first carried the installed 2.1.0 and the two commits after it change only plugin.json, so the source is the same either way. The maker's user manual says the amplitude modulation is applied equally to all generated waveforms, and the code applies it to the sine, triangle, sawtooth and square only, leaving the noise output at full level; the lines say so. The manual calls the duty cycle control the PWM knob and the panel prints PW. The panel prints no name at all on the pulse width modulation knob or its jack, only a line joining them to PW. The PW knob's own range runs from 0.1% to 99.9%, but the square wave clamps the total to 1% and 99%, so the last of the knob's travel at each end makes no difference. The module has no context menu of its own. Nothing here is polyphonic: every jack is read with getVoltage() and no channel, and nothing calls setChannels or getPolyVoltage.
